topic: 3D build story: a garden fence that escalates into a stadium (new 'home engineering that spirals' format, after @hiddenhome.3d's style)
format: longform3d: one continuous camera, one word on screen at a time, ~60 s. Only the fence-building opening is fact; everything after the football is a deliberate joke.
taste: Our own world, models and story - nothing copied from the reference reels. Box people only, no faces.

claims.claim: A 6 ft fence post goes in a hole about 600 mm deep.
A little gravel at the bottom of the hole helps water drain away from the post.
Posts are set in fast-setting concrete (postcrete), which holds within minutes.
A gravel board sits under the panel to keep the timber off the wet ground.
A standard fence panel is 1.83 m wide.
In England a fence can be up to 2 m high without planning permission where it is not next to a highway (exceptions: listed buildings, some conservation areas).

rejected: 'ten minutes' for the concrete (one guide only) - script says 'in minutes'
